Title: Q: Archon Investigation vs Secure Haven

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
A vampire with a Secure Haven attempts to bleed his or her prey for 6
pool, and his or her prey plays an Archon Investigation. So, is the AI's
cost increased by 1 due to the Secure Haven?. I think it is.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.
